site_name: Avon House Estate, Oxford Street, London, W1C 1JN
description: Redevelopment of the city block bounded by Oxford Street, Gee’s Court, Barrett Street and Stratford Place, comprising the deep retrofit, refurbishment and extension of Coin House (2 Gee’s Court) and 20 Stratford Place/360–366 Oxford Street (Grade II listed), substantial demolition, alteration and redevelopment of Swan House (17–19 Stratford Place), and the demolition and replacement of 4 Gee’s Court. The proposals include an infill extension within the central courtyard and rooftop extensions across the site to provide accommodation over basement, ground and eight upper floors, together with terraces, greening, photovoltaic panels and associated plant enclosures above roof level. Associated external and internal works include alterations to façades, fenestration and access arrangements. The development will facilitate the enlargement, enhancement and rationalisation of the existing buildings to provide retail (Class E), office (Class E) and food and beverage uses (flexible Class E and/or Sui Generis) (in conjunction with the Listed Building planning application PA/2026/0151)
